text:
Nina Torres: Starting a quick thread for NewCo QBR cost/prep. Need 30/60/90 token snapshot, embed pilot delta, onboarding blockers, and a recommendation for a contingency credit. @Omar can you grab the windows?

Omar Haddad: On it. Pulling raw totals now. Do we want Hosted+Dedic blended or separate lines?

Nina Torres: Separate lines for clarity, but include a blended row in the summary slide. Also highlight any one-off spikes and their root cause.

Sofia Morales: FYI their onboarding stalled because API key rotation failed for a week, that suppressed mobile traffic. I can quantify the seat activation gap.

Omar Haddad: Draft numbers:
```
30d: 22.4M tokens (hosted 20.1M, dedic-embed 2.3M)
60d: 45.9M
90d: 71.2M
Current run-rate: ~0.74M tokens/day
Forecast baseline (90d): 78-95M tokens
```

Nina Torres: Can you produce conservative/expected/optimistic scenarios with embed conversion assumptions? Also estimate percent variance vs last renewal quarter.

Omar Haddad: Sure. Conservative = no embed uplift; expected = 20% embed conversion; optimistic = 40% conversion. Will add percent deltas.

Sofia Morales: Onboarding note: API key rotation bug blocked 18% of MAUs for ~9 days. Once resolved, expected reactivation over 3 weeks.

cs-bot: Reminder: QBR template has a "budget-risk" slot. Link: https://redwood.company/qbr-templates

Nina Torres: Mitigations to recommend: 1) temporary quota cap on nightly exports (3x median guard), 2) batch-size guidance for embed jobs, 3) one-off credit ask to cover platform-caused spikes.

Omar Haddad: Quick staging test: setting batch_size=256 reduced embed token-cost ~15% with negligible latency impact. Will include perf snippet.

Sofia Morales: Ill add onboarding timeline and action owner for API keys. Also request a short enablement session for their devs on batching knobs.

Nina Torres: Action items:
- Omar: slides + scenario table by Mon 9am PT
- Sofia: onboarding impact + timeline by Mon noon
- Nina: draft exec ask (credit range) and negotiation points by Tue EOD

Omar Haddad: Uploaded numbers to drive: https://drive.redwood/newco/qbr-numbers. Will tag Nina.

Sofia Morales: Leaving a comment on the slide draft re: wording for procurement.

Nina Torres: Great. Final note: call out that projected variance >12% without mitigations could cause procurement to request credit terms. Make that a headline in the exec summary.

cs-bot: Scheduled reminder "NewCo QBR finalize" Tue 17:00 UTC.

Omar Haddad: Final deck out Mon 9am PT.

Nina Torres: Thanks team, closing loop. :thumbsup:
